## Requirements: The ability to associate a unique ID generated by another authority (local or global) to the record (Experimental) 

| | |
| :--- | :--- |
| *Official URL*:http://smart.who.int/dak-immz/Requirements/IMMZFXNREQ056 | *Version*:1.1.1 |
| Active as of 2026-11-18 | *Computable Name*:The ability to associate a unique ID generated by another authority (local or global) to the record |

 
As a [Health worker](ActorDefinition-healthworker.md), I want: 
>  
The ability to associate a unique ID generated by another authority (local or global) to the record 
 
so that 
>  
The record can be more easily shared or identified with other appropriate systems
